scope: Incremental active-text dependency cost; not a whole-product performance certification
decisionRule: E02 must compare native and ProseMirror on the same device, corpus, font policy and this protocol; every absolute profile cap and every candidate-minus-native increment must pass. Correctness is required independently. Missing samples are unverified, never pass. Changing thresholds requires a new version and a new decision, never retroactive edits.

protocol.percentile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over ascending samples
protocol.cold: fresh Chromium process/context per sample; file:// navigation; OS disk caches not flushed
protocol.warm: reload same page/context immediately after cold sample
protocol.startupEnd: PPTEPortable ready, document.fonts.ready, all image decode promises, then two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; time from navigation time origin
protocol.input: public editText Operation Engine commit through two animation frames; explicit API-to-paint latency, not OS keyboard or IME latency
protocol.corpus: scripts/evolution-baseline.mjs: fixed blackbox core slide repeated 12/30/100 times, image removed, no binary fonts; record canonical revision and actual HTML SHA256
protocol.evidence: Keep all raw samples, p50/p95, application commit, fixture revision, HTML digest and font policy. Startup and each interaction are separate; instrument document correctness and unrelated-node stability when evaluating E02. Font/resource timeout fails a sample; fallback requires a new explicit configuration. Real Safari and lower-performance hardware remain unverified until physically measured.
